name: Blood of the Swift: Blitz Assault

system.description: Once per turn, as part of making an attack when you cast a jutsu, you can spend 2 Speed Seals to make one additional attack of the same type, dealing 2d8 damage on a hit and reapplying the jutsu’s non-damaging effect on a success, if any. This damage increases to 4d8 at 7th, and 6d8 at 15th level.
